name: Permanente (Permanent Resident / Inmigrante)

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of legal residence in Peru under a qualifying prior status (Religioso, Inversionista, Trabajador, Investigación, Familiar de Residente, or an official/consular/diplomatic category), without absences exceeding 3 continuous months or 6 alternating months within any one year.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous legal residence under a qualifying prior status.

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum economic solvency of 10 UIT (S/55,000 in 2026) in annual gross income.
Interpol international background check (except for minors).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 3 years' continuous legal residence under a qualifying status
Proof of annual income of 10 UIT or more

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.m: Permanente resident status, indefinite duration, granted after 3 years as a legal resident under a qualifying category
Veninformado -- Permanente status: 3-year residence requirement with absence limits, list of qualifying prior categories, 10 UIT annual income threshold, Interpol clearance
